fuentes: Powerball.com, 'Prizes and Odds': jackpot odds 1 in 292,201,338 (5 of 69 white balls + 1 of 26 red Powerballs); overall odds of winning any prize 1 in 24.87

frases.texto: You think a Powerball ticket is a long shot. It's much longer than that.
frases.estilo: Dry, direct, with a half smile.

frases.texto: The odds of winning the jackpot are one in two hundred ninety-two million.
frases.estilo: Matter of fact, then a beat of disbelief.

frases.texto: Picture that many balls, and only one is gold. Your ticket picks one.
And every combination has the same odds: your birthday, a quick pick, or one-two-three-four-five.
The Powerball website says the odds of winning any prize at all are about one in twenty-five.
Heads up: those are the odds for one ticket in one drawing. Ten tickets means ten chances out of two hundred ninety-two million.
